integrity: Proof gives exact moment identities, sharp asymptotic lower/upper bounds, and complete finite two-tooth minimizer classification. Included checker provides finite exact-rational corroboration, not a proof of infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: Continuous-time unit-rate-per-edge nearest-neighbor walks on finite combs; a single absorbing backbone endpoint; fixed backbone length in the large-budget limit; no heterogeneous rates or stochastic ordering. Independent scientific validation not undertaken. General tree first-passage variance formulas are known; the originality assessment concerns constrained variance optimization and spatial design.
title: Variance-optimal tooth allocation in a finite transport comb
